tool_calls.literal: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '*' | sort && wc -l samples.jsonl && sed -n '1,3p' samples.jsonl"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' README.md; jq -r '.stack_frames[] + \"\\t\" + (.value|tostring)' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{s["'$1]+=$2; n[$1]++} END {for(k in s) print s[k],n[k],k}'"' | sort -nr | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc "jq -r '[.value, .labels.source_session[0], (.stack_frames[]|select(startswith(\"result:\"))), (.stack_frames[]|select(startswith(\"action:\"))), (.stack_frames[]|select(startswith(\"strategy:\")))] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{v="'$1; side=(v>0?"bad":"good"); mag=(v<0?-v:v); key=side FS $3; val[key]+=mag; sess[key FS $2]=1; act[side FS $3 FS $4]+=mag} END {for(k in val){split(k,a,FS); ns=0; for(x in sess){split(x,b,FS); if(b[1]==a[1]&&b[2]==a[2])ns++} print val[k],ns,a[1],a[2]}}'"' | sort -nr | head -30; jq -r 'select(any(.stack_frames[]; .==\"result:repeated\")) | [.value, .labels.source_session[0], (.stack_frames[]|select(startswith(\"action:\"))), (.stack_frames[]|select(startswith(\"strategy:\")))] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{side=("'$1>0?"bad":"good"); v=($1<0?-$1:$1); n[side]+=$1; mag[side]+=v; sess[side FS $2]=1; act[side FS $3]+=v; strat[side FS $4]+=v} END {for(s in mag){ns=0;for(x in sess){split(x,a,FS);if(a[1]==s)ns++} print "TOTAL",s,"signed",n[s],"magnitude",mag[s],"sessions",ns}; for(x in act) print "ACTION",x,act[x]; for(x in strat) print "STRATEGY",x,strat[x]}'"' | sort"
